fixed_design.name: クルミョネ
fixed_design.body: Exactly two smooth rounded pebble-like body segments arranged horizontally: a small front segment and a larger rear segment. Soft moss-like skin and exactly three large smooth rounded scales placed on top of the larger segment, no ring of scales. Exactly two round eyes on the small front segment, exactly six short rounded legs: two beneath the small segment and four beneath the large segment, all six distinct and visible. Exactly one short rounded leaf-shaped tail behind. No arms, ears or wings.
fixed_design.pose: Front small segment leans low, as if gently sniffing toward the ground, still facing image-right. Patient peaceful posture.

expanded_prompts.sm-scaled-024-normal-attempt001.txt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one original, gentle fantasy creature for a hand-drawn 2D creature-raising game.
Create exactly ONE new full-body creature, not based on any existing character.
Locked v2 anatomy and materials: Exactly two smooth rounded pebble-like body segments arranged horizontally: a small front segment and a larger rear segment. Soft moss-like skin and exactly three large smooth rounded scales placed on top of the larger segment, no ring of scales. Exactly two round eyes on the small front segment, exactly six short rounded legs: two beneath the small segment and four beneath the large segment, all six distinct and visible. Exactly one short rounded leaf-shaped tail behind. No arms, ears or wings.
Locked pose and personality: Front small segment leans low, as if gently sniffing toward the ground, still facing image-right. Patient peaceful posture.
Palette roles primary / secondary / dark accent, respectively: #C5A575 / #D8BEAA / #5B657B. Preserve the primary color on the main body, secondary on scales or tufts or soft wings, dark accent for contours and eyes.
Mandatory identifiers: small front and large rear rounded pebble segments; front two legs plus rear four legs; three large rounded dorsal scales and short leaf tail.
Style: clear variable-width dark colored outline, restrained three-step cel shading, soft upper-left lighting, modest tactile material cues, appealing proportions. No photorealism or glossy 3D rendering.
Composition: full body, light top-down three-quarter view. Output MUST be exactly 1024 by 1024 pixels RGBA PNG. Center the creature inside the central 80 percent of the square; its longest extent 800–850 pixels and at least 80 completely transparent pixels on each edge. Show all specified appendages distinctly, no cropping.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, no drawn checkerboard, no ground, no shadow, no glow. Depict only the creature; no habitat, rocks, leaves, props, clothing, scenery, text, letters, logos, watermarks, frames or extra anatomy.
expanded_prompts.sm-scaled-024-normal-attempt002.txt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image: the new original design-v2 candidate for sm-scaled-024, SHA256 5b462c5cbe56b133d2b1a8562c0e6c440103478113be8f8af972216fcb75a45b. This request edits only this newly generated friendly creature.
Required targeted quality correction: Correct the leg count and distribution. The large rear segment must have EXACTLY FOUR legs total, arranged as two pairs, and the small front segment must have EXACTLY TWO legs total, one pair. The input appears to have five rear legs; remove the extra rear leg and show exactly SIX distinct leg ends total. Keep two rounded body segments, three dorsal rounded scales, two eyes and one leaf tail. Do not change the rest of the character.
Keep all other anatomy, proportions, palette placement, viewing angle, pose and expression the same.
Complete design constraints: Exactly two smooth rounded pebble-like body segments arranged horizontally: a small front segment and a larger rear segment. Soft moss-like skin and exactly three large smooth rounded scales placed on top of the larger segment, no ring of scales. Exactly two round eyes on the small front segment, exactly six short rounded legs: two beneath the small segment and four beneath the large segment, all six distinct and visible. Exactly one short rounded leaf-shaped tail behind. No arms, ears or wings.
Palette: #C5A575 / #D8BEAA / #5B657B.
Maintain a clean hand-drawn 2D fantasy game illustration with a dark outline and restrained three-step cel shading. Full body, one character, transparent background. Do not add any scene, objects, text or extra body features.
Output must be a 1024 by 1024 RGBA PNG. Center the subject with at least 80 pixels entirely transparent on every edge, its longest extent 800–850 pixels. No cropped parts, ground, shadow, glow, watermark or frames.
expanded_prompts.sm-scaled-024-normal-attempt003.txt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct only the feet of the newly created original design-v2 creature in the input. Identity reference SHA256 8f7f8319315989023e6789a8feed46e3a701a6da89b27d3b5627c831d88cd58f.
The creature needs exactly SIX short feet: two beneath the small front body and four beneath the large rear body. The current image has only five visible foot ends. Reposition the rear feet to show two left/right pairs rather than three near-side feet: keep TWO near-side feet beneath the large rear body and clearly expose TWO far-side feet emerging between them or beyond the far outline. Keep the small front body on its TWO own feet. Total count: rear near two + rear far two + front two = six. Make each foot readable, separate and unambiguously attached to the correct segment. Gently lift the body or spread feet outward only as needed to expose the complete six-foot structure. Do not add seventh feet. No labels or numbers in the image.
Keep all other identity features: small rounded front body with two eyes, larger rounded moss-textured rear body, exactly three large back scales, one short rounded leaf tail, brown/tan/slate palette, gentle forward-leaning posture, same three-quarter view facing image-right.
Full body single creature, transparent background, clean dark outline, restrained cel shading. 1024x1024 RGBA PNG with minimum 80px transparent padding on every edge and subject extent 800–850px. No ground, shadow, glow, scenery, props, text or additional anatomy.
expanded_prompts.sm-scaled-024-pixel-attempt001.txt:
Use case: style-transfer. Redraw the exact single original design-v2 creature in this image as authentic deliberately designed pixel art. Reference SHA256 2d26b458d7ba4e932bf3aae624ab5a6f5d68f67a50aaf81b9972d6d444d70066.
Preserve the exact two-segment shape: small front and large rear rounded moss-covered bodies. Exactly TWO eyes on the front segment. Exactly SIX legs: FOUR on the large rear segment (three larger foot ends and one partially occluded far foot are visible in the reference perspective), plus TWO on the small front segment. All six foot ends must remain countable. Exactly THREE large pale rounded scales on the larger segment's back, exactly ONE short rounded leaf tail. No ears, arms, wings or additional structures. Preserve proportions, pose, direction toward image-right and the normal's exact color placement. Palette primary #C5A575, secondary #D8BEAA, accent #5B657B.
Change only the medium, no redesign. Output exact 128 by 128 RGBA PNG master, not an upscaled preview. Genuine regular 1-pixel grid, deliberate clusters, 1–2 pixel outline, stepped contour, maximum 32 opaque RGB colors, binary alpha only 0/255. No antialiasing, blur, smooth gradients or translucent pixels. Simplify moss texture into sparse intentional clusters.
Single full creature centered, longest extent 100–108 pixels, minimum 10 fully transparent pixels on every side. No ground, cast shadow, glow, backdrop, text, logos, frame or extra objects.
